item.tib: rma rgyal pom ra'i mchod bskang
item.coloph: ces pa'i gnyen chen pom ra'i bskangs (skong) ba 'di/ bstan pa bsrung ba'i don du smar ro/ bstan srung pom ra'i srog sgrub skong ba 'di/ khod po blo gros thogs med nas/ rim par brgyud do/ brgyud pa'i tshe dbang rig 'dzin/ khod po blo gros thogs med/ sras blo gros nam mkha'/ khod po sdang ye shes/ shes rab blo gros/ mkhas grub mnyam med shes rab rgyal mtshan/ mtshungs med bsod nams rgyal mtshan nas rim bzhin brgyud pa'o//
